sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: 27B Model Beats 397B on Coding (2026)
sources.snippet: The 397B model Qwen3.6-27B just outperformed (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) only activates 17B parameters per token despite its enormous total size. MoE is efficient at scale but introduces routing complexity and makes local deployment extremely hardware-hungry.
